_comment: LAPACK validation tests that are known to fail on main, each with the issue that tracks the
defect. scripts/run-lapack-validation.py reports these as known and fails a run only for a
failure that is not listed here, or for an entry that has started passing (so a fix has to
remove its entry in the same change). Never add a test without the issue that describes it.

known.note: GET22-style residual violations on the nonsymmetric EVD fixtures
